_readme: Contract-type cue lexicon (DESIGN.md §4.1 `types`). Scored over the document
title plus its first blocks; the highest-scoring type wins, and a document
that matches nothing is typed `other`. Edit freely.
A cue in `title` scores 3, a cue in the opening text scores 1 (capped at 3).
